desc: Cookie Crisp Chocolate Chip Cookie Flavored Cereal is packed with nutrients and contains complete grains, which can help fuel your morning. That's why whole grain is the first ingredient in all Big G cereals and why Cookie Crisp has no high fructose corn syrup. Goodness first. This cereal contains 14g whole grain per serving; at least 48 grams recommended daily. A whole grain food is made by using all three parts of the grain. All General Mills Big G cereals contain more whole grain than any other single ingredient.
features:
Chocolate-chip cookie–shaped cereal that’s fun and flavorful for breakfast or snacks 

Contains whole grain; at least 10–14 g whole grain per serving 

Fortified with 12 essential vitamins and minerals (including Vitamin D, Calcium, Iron, Zinc, B vitamins)

No high-fructose corn syrup, no artificial flavors or colors from artificial sources
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn; Sugar; Corn Meal; Cocoa (processed with alkali); Brown Sugar Syrup; Canola and/or Sunflower Oil; Corn Flour; Corn Syrup; Salt; Baking Soda; Natural Flavor; Annatto Extract (Color); Rosemary Extract; Vitamins & Minerals (Calcium Carbonate, Tricalcium Phosphate, Vitamin C as Sodium Ascorbate, Iron, Zinc, Niacinamide, Vitamin B6, Thiamin Mononitrate, Vitamin A Palmitate, Riboflavin, Folic Acid, Vitamin B12, Vitamin D₃)
